repo.description:
### Summary

In OpenBao's AppRole (affecting Role IDs), Cert Auth (affecting CRLs), LDAP Auth (affecting groups and users), and RADIUS Auth (affecting users), ACL denies were unable to function properly due to implicit path canonicalization which occurred in these plugins. This vulnerability is a continuation of GHSA-fg5x-7whg-6c28 / CVE-2026-104093.

This vulnerability is original to HashiCorp Vault.

### Patches

This is patched in OpenBao v2.7.2. A special v2.6.5 release has been cut but note that v2.6.x series is officially unsupported upstream; please migrate to the v2.7.x series.
repo.summary: ACL Bypass via Non-Canonical URL Access in OpenBao's AppRole, Cert Auth, LDAP, and RADIUS plugins
